<!-- Share what you know. You do not need to complete every section, identify a standard, write code, or propose a fix. You do not need to disclose a diagnosis. Issues are public, so share only information you are comfortable making public. -->

## What were you trying to do?

<!-- Describe the task and include a link to the affected page, component, or example if available. -->

## What happened?

<!-- Describe what made the task difficult or prevented you from continuing, and what you expected instead. -->

## Steps to reproduce

<!-- If you can, describe the steps that led to the issue. A code example is welcome but not required. -->

## Environment

<!-- Include any details you have about the package version, browser, operating system, and assistive technology you used. Include versions where available. You do not need to confirm that your environment is officially supported. -->

## Workarounds and additional context

<!-- Describe any workaround you found or other information that may help. Screenshots and recordings are optional; describe the relevant behavior in text as well. -->
